bibliographic_scope.title: Photoluminescence characteristics of neodymium oxide nanocrystal/titania/ormosil composite sol-gel thin films
bibliographic_scope.authors: W. X. Que; Y. Zhou; Y. L. Lam; C. H. Kam; J. Zhou; K. Pita; Y. C. Chan; S. Buddhudu; L. H. Gan; G. R. Deen

source_interpretation.text: The phase diagram guided selection of 15/60/25 wt% surfactant/oil/aqueous phases. Only the neodymium feed has total charged masses; receiver amount and mixing ratio remain unknown.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, Experimental procedure and Figure 1

source_interpretation.text: The TEM/SAED evidence describes oxide particles. Composite-film and host-only PL curves are separate source contexts, not additional independently characterized nanoparticle batches.

Residual water/organics, pore formation and surfactant passivation are proposed explanations. The 1145 nm shoulder is tentatively attributed to the host; the source states that its mechanism is unclear.

microemulsion_scope.feed: 30.22 g NP-5/NP-9(2:1 mass ratio), 120.88 g cyclohexane, 50.36 g of 0.5 M aqueous Nd(NO3)3; respective fractions 15/60/25 wt%.
microemulsion_scope.receiver: NP-5/NP-9(2:1 mass ratio), cyclohexane, 0.5 M oxalic acid aqueous phase at 15/60/25 wt%; total amount and mixing ratio unreported.
microemulsion_scope.phase_diagram: Room-temperature titration/Vortex mixing in screw-capped tubes to determine clear/turbid boundaries; not separate nanocrystal routes.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, Experimental procedure; Figure 1

structural_scope.statement: Needle-like oxide particles and clear SAED rings support nanocrystallinity; no numerical dimensions or phase-indexed/cell refinement. Figure 2 shows 500 nm scale.

characterization.technique: PL at room temperature, 514 nm Ar+ laser 200 mW, 80 Hz mechanical chopping; two lenses, ORIEL 77200 monochromator, ORIEL 71905 detector, lock-in intensity recording and long-pass excitation filter.

host_scope.statement: Titania/GLYMO molar ratio 20%/80%; matrix synthesis stated to be in reference 17, unreviewed here. Figure 4 host-only labels 100/200/300/500 °C; do not infer unshown 400/600 °C curves.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2–3, Host preparation reference and Figure 4

limitations: Complete supplied four-page main, four figures and 19 bibliography entries. SI and cited full sources unreviewed.

The receiving oxalic-acid microemulsion composition is reported, but its total charge and the relative amounts of the two microemulsions are not. No equal-mass/equal-volume or neodymium-to-oxalate ratio is assumed.
The oxide preparation is a source-described route with incomplete batch charge information, not a complete reproducible laboratory SOP.

Room temperature and overnight are literal source descriptions, not assigned numerical temperature or duration. Addition/stirring rates, centrifugation settings, wash volume, vacuum pressure, calcination atmosphere/ramp, precursor recovery and final yield are unreported.
Neodymium oxalate hydrate/formula is not specified. NP-5/NP-9 are source-defined surfactant grades, not single exact oligomers with measured coordinates.
The titania/GLYMO matrix synthesis is deferred to reference 17, whose full text was not reviewed. Its titanium precursor, solvent/catalyst, charges, hydrolysis and aging are not reconstructed.

Six composite-film baking conditions are retained as supporting processing/property contexts; their common host synthesis is incomplete and they do not receive independent nanocrystal structure-pair credit.

TEM describes needle-like particles and SAED rings establish nanocrystallinity; no particle dimensions, crystal polymorph/cell or measured atomic coordinates are supplied. No size was digitized from the 500 nm TEM scale.

The source identifies the oxide as Nd2O3, but does not provide phase-indexed diffraction or quantitative compositional analysis. Film spectra and host spectra must not inherit standalone-particle structure evidence.
Independent source comparison passed; molecular/particle/reference-cell presentation remains pending.

evidence_conflicts.description: The source says main peak width hardly changes for 200–600 °C and separately says above 200 °C. Series-level about 46 nm is retained as shared source description rather than independently fitted values.
